name: Git vault versioning
description: Tracks a vault or project with local Git commits in a host-rendered source control view.

gitExecutablePath.title: Git executable
gitExecutablePath.description: Absolute path to a Git executable. Leave empty to use the Git the host finds in its own fixed locations.

githubExecutablePath.title: GitHub CLI executable
githubExecutablePath.description: Absolute path to the GitHub CLI (gh). Leave empty to use the one the host finds in its own fixed locations. Only used when authentication is set to GitHub sign-in.

authenticationMode.title: Remote authentication
authenticationMode.description: How Denote authenticates fetch, pull, push, and clone. Public needs no credentials, SSH agent uses your running agent, and GitHub sign-in asks the host's GitHub CLI for a token that never reaches this plugin.

pullStrategy.title: Pull strategy
pullStrategy.description: How a pull combines remote work with yours. Fast-forward only never creates a merge and never rewrites history.

defaultBranch.title: Default branch
defaultBranch.description: Branch name used when you initialize a repository from Denote.

authorName.title: Commit author name
authorName.description: Optional name recorded on commits Denote creates. Leave empty to use the repository's own Git identity.

authorEmail.title: Commit author email
authorEmail.description: Optional email recorded on commits Denote creates. Leave empty to use the repository's own Git identity.

autoCommitIntervalMinutes.title: Automatic commit interval
autoCommitIntervalMinutes.description: Whole minutes between automatic local commits of tracked changes. Zero disables automatic commits.

autoCommitMessage.title: Automatic commit message
autoCommitMessage.description: Message recorded on each automatic local commit.

includePatterns.title: Include patterns
includePatterns.description: Comma-separated relative path prefixes included in automatic commits. Empty means the whole scope.

excludePatterns.title: Exclude patterns
excludePatterns.description: Comma-separated relative path prefixes excluded from automatic commits. Excludes win over includes.
